question: What is in the ULB credit-card fraud table, and which rows will Challenge 3 hold out?
split rule: Sort by Time ascending, then row id ascending. dev_cut = n * 60 // 100 and test_cut = n * 80 // 100, then snap each cut backward so an equal Time stays entirely on the later side. Train is [0, dev_cut), dev is [dev_cut, test_cut), test is [test_cut, n). Time may not cross a boundary. See notes/creditcard-audit.md.
metric: positive_rate (table fact, not a model score)
decision: Use this time-ordered split for Challenge 3. Fit on train, choose the threshold on dev, touch test once. Do not ship a model from this audit.
